trends.name: learned-signal-context-latency
trends.title: Model-isolated generic-classifier path by context and enabled count
trends.description: CPU-safe view of generic learned classifier signals. The curve includes Router scheduling, score aggregation, synchronization, allocations, and deterministic full-input stub work; it does not claim neural inference latency or represent other learned-signal families.

trends.name: learned-signal-request-batch-latency
trends.title: Router batch latency by enabled generic-classifier count
trends.description: Model-isolated concurrent request batches at a fixed 2K-token context using generic learned classifier signals. Use the throughput chart beside it to distinguish latency growth from useful parallelism.

trends.name: learned-signal-request-batch-throughput
trends.title: Router throughput by request batch and generic-classifier count
trends.description: Model-isolated requests per second from the same controlled generic learned classifier sweep; absolute values are advisory on shared CI hosts.

trends.name: request-context-latency
trends.title: Request extraction latency by context length
trends.description: Real ExtProc parsing with one message and no tools; the production-like pairwise request shapes remain separate regression points.
